## Scientific publishing, open access and research integrity

### IA na redação científica: ética, regras editoriais e boas práticas de reporte {#ia-escrita-cientifica}

*Upcoming · October 2026, annual meeting of the Graduate Programme in Animal Biology, UFMS
(Campo Grande) · and December 2026, UNILA (Foz do Iguaçu) · 40 min · in Portuguese*

Where generative AI stands in the writing of a scientific paper: authorship
and responsibility, the policies of the five largest publishers plus Cambridge
and OUP, Brazil's CNPq Ordinance nº 2.664/2026, COPE's position, the known
limits of LLMs, and the AIdIT framework for reporting AI use. Every quoted
policy comes from the publisher's own page; the deck closes with its own AI
use declaration.

Companion hands-on workshop: [*IA na revisão de literatura*](teaching.html#past-courses-short-courses).

[{{< fa solid display >}} Open the slides](https://provetelab.org/ia-escrita-cientifica/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
&nbsp;
[{{< fa brands github >}} Source](https://github.com/diogoprov/ia-escrita-cientifica){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

### Boas práticas para redação e submissão de artigos {#wiley-redacao}

*27 de maio de 2025 · webinário da Wiley em parceria com o Portal de
Periódicos da CAPES, sob o título "Dominando a escrita acadêmica: boas
práticas, erros a evitar e estratégias de submissão" · in Portuguese*

What editors and reviewers actually look for, from choosing a journal to
responding to a decision letter — aimed at graduate students and early-career
researchers publishing in English as a second language.

*2025 · Wiley Customer Education · in Portuguese*

Routes to open access, what transformative agreements do and do not cover, and

### Equity in open access publishing {#alspp-equity}

*2024 · Panel — Association of Learned and Professional Society Publishers (ALPSP)*

Invited panellist. Article processing charges as a barrier that moves the
paywall from reading to publishing, and what waiver schemes miss when the
constraint is institutional rather than individual.

[{{< fa solid file-pdf >}} Slides (PDF)](talks/2024-alpsp-equity-open-access.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Community ecology and evolution

### The other story told by urban ecology in the Global South {#idiv-urban}

*iDiv Seminar Series — German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research
(Halle-Jena-Leipzig), September 2024 · and Universität Bielefeld, 2025 · in
English*

Urban ecology written from the Global South rather than read from it: what
changes in the questions, in the study systems and in the conclusions when the
cities under study are Campo Grande and São José dos Campos instead of the
northern-hemisphere cities that dominate the literature. Given while a Humboldt
fellow on sabbatical at iDiv.

The slides below are the 2025 Bielefeld version of the talk.

[{{< fa solid file-pdf >}} Slides (PDF, 69 pp.)](talks/2024-idiv-urban-ecology-global-south.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

### Biogeography and macroevolution of anuran amphibians in the Brazilian Atlantic Forest {#swansea}

*13 April 2017 · Science Club, Department of Biosciences, Swansea University,
UK · in English*

How the anuran assemblages of the Brazilian Atlantic Forest came to be what
they are: biogeographic history, diversification, and what phylogenetic
comparative methods can and cannot tell us about it.

[{{< fa solid file-pdf >}} Slides (PDF)](talks/2017-swansea-science-club.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
